name: CL9V_validation_chain_24k_20260811_r4
objective: Replicate and bound the positive small-face ROI result, test per-image precise occluder ownership, and replicate Marion roll across diagnostic seeds while retaining one scarce A100 allocation for the entire chain.

chain.name: CL9V_smallface_roi_suffix_multiseed_24k_r4
chain.single_change: Sweep DDIM50 ROI suffix lengths 14, 16, 18, and 20 at seeds 0, 1, 2, and 3; all crop, expansion, scale, feather, checkpoint, and prompt controls remain fixed.
chain.seed_contract: Seed 0 is standard validation. Seeds 1-3 are explicitly labelled diagnostic exceptions and alter only the 16 refined ROI targets; copied rows remain the exact seed-0 historical baseline.
gates: 80/80 non-target rows exact RGB for every arm
16/16 target composites exact outside their declared ROI
seed-0 18-step arm exact RGB reproduction of completed r3
subject-v2 and TOPIQ-Face outputs for every arm
chain.decision_gate: Promote one setting only if non-Eddie mean ID gain is at least +0.07, at least 75% of target rows win across diagnostic seeds, TOPIQ change is at least -0.01, mask-IoU change is at least -0.02, all outside-ROI pixels are exact, and no reviewed row has a pasted-face seam or expression regression.

chain.name: CL9V_occluder_oracle_geometry_24k_r4
chain.single_change: Replace the rejected family-wide rectangle/ellipse with manually reviewed per-image polygons tracing the baseline goggles, hands, fingers, or overlapping hair.
chain.routing_invariant: Visibility can remove reference ownership from target queries only; reference K/V, reference mask, native lane, pose_adapt_ratio, and CA mixing remain unchanged.
chain.oracle_limitation: Polygons are informed by the exact first-pass baseline and are not a deployable first-pass inference mechanism.
gates: CPU geometry preflight covers exactly 16 expected rows
each mask blocks 2%-50% of its generation bbox
subject-v2 and TOPIQ-Face outputs plus full visual review
chain.decision_gate: Continue to a learned gate only if at least 5/7 non-Eddie Skiing identities win, mean mask-IoU changes by at least -0.02, TOPIQ is non-decreasing, and blinded review confirms the intended occluder stays in place. Crying is evaluated separately and is expected to be neutral rather than negative.

chain.name: CL9V_marion_roll_multiseed_24k_r4
chain.single_change: Compare the original Marion photograph with the completed -7.65 degree same-canvas roll correction at seeds 0-3; scoring reference and propagated/redetected boxes remain controlled.
chain.seed_zero_source: Completed r3 original historical baseline and Marion roll outputs
chain.new_arms: Original and roll for seeds 1-3. Only indices 84-95 change seed; indices 0-83 remain seed-0 RGB sentinels.
gates: 84/84 non-Marion rows exact RGB for all six new arms
same source file and unchanged subject-v2 scoring vector
subject-v2 and TOPIQ-Face outputs for original/roll at each seed
chain.decision_gate: Retain roll as opt-in preprocessing only if aggregate mean ID gain is at least +0.02, at least 70% of pairs win, TOPIQ does not decrease, and no prompt family loses more than 0.05 ID on average.
